description: This Kotlin file defines an Android Fragment class 'PermissionsCenterFragment' that provides a user interface for managing and requesting various permissions (Location, Media, SMS). It interacts with a PermissionsManager to handle permission states, requests, and settings navigation, and dynamically updates UI elements based on permission statuses.

classes.name: PermissionsCenterFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays and manages permission statuses for Location, Media, and SMS, allowing users to request permissions or open system settings accordingly.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets up event handlers after the view has been created.

methods.name: setupActions
methods.description: Sets click listeners for permission action buttons to handle permission requests or settings navigation.

methods.name: bindStates
methods.description: Updates UI elements to reflect current permission statuses for each permission group.
